name: LanceDB
model: Tables in the Lance columnar format holding vectors, text, images and more; vector, full-text and hybrid search with filters
engine_note: Lance columnar format with versioned manifests; IVF-based indexes (IVF_PQ, IVF_RQ, IVF_HNSW_SQ/PQ/FLAT); files on local disk or object storage (S3, GCS, Azure)
consistency: Each write commits a new immutable table version atomically (MVCC, ACID per table) using put-if-not-exists or rename on the store; concurrent writers use optimistic concurrency with rebase. Readers see a snapshot and may lag new versions.
scaling: Embedded: runs inside your process, scales with the machine and storage; data can sit in object storage so many readers share it. LanceDB Cloud and Enterprise add a distributed, serverless query layer.
version_note: Python package lancedb 0.39.0; GitHub shows only 0.40.0 betas on its first page. Underlying Lance format library pylance is 12.0.0 (2026-09-17).
reach: Reach for it when embeddings live next to multimodal data (images, text, features) for training or RAG, and you want a library with no server, storing on S3.
avoid: Avoid for high-rate small transactional writes from many clients, or when you need a shared always-on server without paying for LanceDB Cloud.
escape: It keeps vectors with large multimodal training data in columnar files on object storage, no server to run.
chat: Offline: message embeddings and eval datasets on S3 for analysis and retrieval experiments.
notes: Index quote: 'LanceDB supports IVF-HNSW-based quantized indexes IVF_HNSW_FLAT, IVF_HNSW_PQ, and IVF_HNSW_SQ.' Commit model quotes (lance.org transaction spec): 'Each commit creates a new immutable table version through atomic storage operations.'; 'Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) to provide ACID transaction guarantees for concurrent readers and writers'; 'exactly one writer succeeds when multiple writers attempt to create the same manifest file concurrently'. Storage doc lists 'Object storage (S3 / GCS / Azure Blob)' and local NVMe. GitHub releases API was rate-limited, so version taken from PyPI JSON (upload 2026-09-17). Managed offerings named from lancedb.com, not re-fetched in detail: unconfirmed names. No Jepsen analysis.
